module AliasArraySignatureUsage

type Money is Integer

function values() returns Array<Money, 3>
    ensures result[0] = 1
is
    return [1, 2, 3]
end values

procedure main()
is
    let amounts: Array<Money, 3> = values()
    let amount: Money = amounts[0]
    check amount = 1
end main

end AliasArraySignatureUsage
